catalogue_name: Sukuu Search Ghana National Metadata Catalogue
scope_statement: Education-first national discovery. Non-education datasets are included only where they materially enrich education, learner, parent, school or institutional decisions.

datasets.name: Ghana Schools Directory
datasets.description: Deployed school discovery surface with searchable directory records, canonical school pages and approximate locality coordinates.

datasets.name: Ghana Administrative Geography
datasets.description: Canonical shared geography layer: Ghana, 16 regions and the integrated 261-district ADM2 layer.

datasets.name: Accredited Tertiary Institutions
datasets.description: Institution-level tertiary accreditation metadata. Ingest from a dated GTEC register snapshot before public entity pages are activated.
datasets.data_quality_note: GTEC public surfaces observed on 10 Sep 2026 expose differing aggregate institution counts; the register snapshot, not a headline count, will be authoritative.

datasets.name: Accredited Tertiary Programmes
datasets.description: Programme-to-institution accreditation metadata for programme-level discovery.

datasets.name: Accredited TVET Providers & Programmes
datasets.description: Provider, programme, NTVETQF level, qualification and accreditation metadata from CTVET.

datasets.name: Approved Learning Resources
datasets.description: NaCCA-approved textbooks and supplementary instructional resources linked to subject, grade/level, publisher and approval metadata.

observations.source_note: Sum of the subject totals in NaCCA December 2024 approved-resource publication.
Sum of NaCCA supplementary category totals in the December 2024 publication.

datasets.name: Scholarships & Education Opportunities
datasets.description: Time-sensitive official scholarship notices, eligibility and deadlines.

datasets.name: Public Libraries
datasets.description: Branch locations and learning-service metadata for proximity to learners and schools.

datasets.name: Education Administration Offices
datasets.description: Regional and district education administration metadata, contacts and jurisdictional relationships.

datasets.name: Licensed Health Facilities Near Schools
datasets.description: Education-contextual proximity layer for licensed health facilities; not a general health directory.

datasets.name: Police & Safety Services Near Schools
datasets.description: Education-contextual safety-service proximity layer; police operational hierarchies remain separate from MMDA geography.

datasets.name: Education & Demographic Indicators
datasets.description: Population, school-age, literacy and related indicators joined only when statistical geography and vintage are explicit.

datasets.name: Digital Address Reference
datasets.description: Potential GhanaPostGPS reference layer for verified entity locations, subject to authorized integration and provenance controls.

datasets.name: Regulated Education-Payment Services
datasets.description: Narrowly scoped regulated financial-service metadata where it supports school fees, education payments or proximity use cases.
